Click the down arrow in the Show Entries box at the top right of the table to display 10, 25, 50, or 100 entries per page. Click the up/down arrow at the top right of each column to sort the table by the respective value. The table can be sorted by more than one value at the same time. For example, to display the Regulations numerically by Regulation Number: Click the Number column once to sort the entries numerically and then click the Type column twice to sort the table by Regulations numerically followed by Polices numerically. In addition, please note the following: The Audience navigation to the left of the table is intended to help various University constituencies see the most common Regulations and Polices which apply to them. It is not intended to display every University rule which may be applicable to a specific individual in every situation. Regulations: Every active University Regulation is available in this table. Polices: The University Policy Group is migrating University Polices to the UF Regulation and Policy Hub. As a result of the phased migration, not all University Policies are currently listed in this table. Please check with specific University units for their respective polices until the University Policy migration is complete.
